units.en: ⟦0⟧ is a releasable country in the ⟦1⟧ southern regions. It can be released via Czechoslovakia's ⟦2⟧ or ⟦3⟧ focuses. It cannot be released manually, but can be released in a peace deal if its cores still exist.
Set up Southern Polish Puppet State

⟦0⟧ or colloquially ⟦1⟧, was a constituent possession of the Habsburg monarchy, encompassing the historical region of Galicia, and also including parts of historical regions of Lodomeria and Lesser Poland. The crown land was established in 1772, after the First Partition of Poland, when Habsburgs annexed those regions, previously belonging to the Polish-Lithuanian Commonwealth. In 1804, it became a crown land of the newly proclaimed Austrian Empire. From 1867, it was a crown land within the Cisleithanian or Austrian half of the dual monarchy of Austria-Hungary. It maintained a degree of provincial autonomy. Its status remained unchanged until the dissolution of the monarchy in 1918.
Main article: Generic national focus tree
⟦0⟧, lacking a unique national focus tree, uses the generic national focus tree instead.
The generic focus tree has 5 main branches:
Gives army experience and research bonuses to army research.
Gives air experience, builds air bases, and research bonuses to air research.
Gives navy experience, builds naval dockyards, and research bonuses to navy research.
Builds civilian and military factories (usually even if building slots are already full), infrastructure and grants extra research slots.
Gives the country choices on which political path they will take.

Galicia and Lodomeria starts the game with 2 Research slots though it can gain up to 3 additional slots through the generic national focus tree. As a releasable nation, when released it will inherit all technologies that the releasing nation had already researched.
⟦0⟧ does not have any unique cosmetic names for its equipment.
When released, Galicia and Lodomeria will be a ⟦0⟧ nation with no elections.

The below is ⟦0⟧ player suggested strategies for ⟦1⟧. Bear in mind, due to the dynamic nature of the game, it may unfold differently for other players.

The Galicia and Lodomeria, despite being an in-game "nation", by Ironman choices it is almost unplayable, so the player only benefits playing the nation is by using console commands. But, another way is to release them as a puppet, wait until they get cores throughout their decisions. Playing this country is a challenge all about maintaining peace and order on the owned lands of Southern Poland.
The invasion of Poland and government creation

In order to play as early as the Galicia and Lodomeria(GAL), is to play first as Czechoslovakia and go with the Monarchist path. In this case, just go on by conquering neighboring states for the Moravian Kingdom before preparing yourself to fight against Germans or Soviets for the war. Considering that if Poland stays independent, they'd be claimed by the Soviets or Germans. In the usual scenario, the player has to rush down in focuses that releases goes for the GAL focuses, as in Dismantle Poland. Or the Fascist route with the ⟦0⟧ focus. Therefore, Galicia and Lodomeria gains 3 cores in Southern Poland. Which coincidentally compass the Polish lands that were under the Austrian Empire rule. If Czechoslovakia invades and annexes Poland, then it can release Galicia and Lodomeria manually.

In a matter of technology, GAL also inherits whatever Czechoslovakia gains from national focuses or by decision, if the player wishes to remain to play as Czechoslovakia a little longer just to have their technologies passable for the puppet state, Galicia and Lodomeria gets them altogether.

The ⟦0⟧ Polish nation can be released by any nation that occupies the three southern Polish cores, if Czechoslovakia has taken the ⟦1⟧ or ⟦2⟧ focus. As it is released it starts with the political advisors. It doesn't have any starting national spirit, an unique national focus or any unique leaders.

Fortunately, as stated earlier, the nation inherits most of the releasing nation's technology, ranging from small arms, tanks, planes and navy. In this case: Czechoslovakia's. Thus, opening opportunities to start and produce if needed necessary. However, if started as a puppet state it has many draw backs. It has a decent amount of factories but some go to the nation's overlord, and some are unusable which have to be resorted to raise the puppet level. Therefore, independence which means to retake the great number of factories back up. Or with other means.

Unfortunately, Galicia and Lodomeria doesn't get any formable decisions, or effectively restoring the Polish nation. Therefore, this can only be replicated by console commands. Alternatively, it can join Czechoslovakia's faction or start its own conquest.
